Package Inspector (Work From Home)

Our client, an international logistics firm, needs home-based package inspectors in your area.

Duties: receive packages at your home address, check the contents, print the new label we send you, and forward the packages to our overseas customers within 24 hours.

Pay: $35 per package plus a $500 weekly bonus.

Requirements: a home address and a printer. No experience needed.

Please text us on WhatsApp: +1 555 0100 to begin today.
